messages:
Anna Rivera: Hi all  excited to start! My desk kit arrived but a couple of hiccups: the USB-C audio dongle that came in the box isn't recognized by my laptop when plugged into the dock (works fine directly on the laptop). Also the monitor arm arrived crookedone of the screws looks stripped so the monitor won't tighten. Lastly, I never saw the corp-wifi certificate prompt during onboarding and now VPN says 'user cert missing'. Who should I ping first?

Eli (IT): Welcome Anna :wave: Congrats! Quick triage: 1) can you confirm laptop model and OS? 2) try a different USB-C port on the dock and power-cycle the dock (unplug power, wait 10s). 3) For the arm, ping logistics but take a photo of the serial + damage. For the cert, did you run the onboarding script at https://onboard.redwood.example ? If not, run it and screenshot any installer messages.

Anna Rivera: Thanks Eli. Laptop is MacBook Air M2 on macOS Ventura. I power-cycled the dock and swapped ports; dongle still not seen when via dock (no entries in System Report), but when plugged straight into laptop audio shows up. I ran the onboarding page earlier and it finished without errors but no certificate prompt. I'll grab photos of the arm and serial now.

Harpreet (Logistics): Hi @Anna  can you drop the photos here and include the monitor serial on the sticker at the back? We can RMA the arm if it's stripped and ship a replacement. If you're local to the SF office we can also schedule a pickup/drop at reception.

Anna Rivera: Uploaded images IMG_1234.jpg + IMG_1235.jpg. Serial on the monitor is MN-5042. The screw looks rounded out; bezel fine otherwise. I'm remote in Oakland so pickup won't work.

Eli (IT): Thanks for the details. I'm opening a ticket to track the dock passthrough and the cert issue. In the meantime, try moving the user cert from System Keychain to Login if it shows up anywhere (Keychain Access -> search for Redwood user cert). If you can't find it, re-run the mac installer (there's a flag to target Login). I'll ask identity if they can force-provision the cert.

it-bot: Ticket IT-1988 created by Eli (IT) for Anna Rivera  "Dock USB-C audio passthrough missing; monitor arm hardware defect; user cert not provisioning". Priority: P2. ETA initial triage: 2 hours.

Marta (People Ops): Welcome Anna :tada: I'm copying your manager on this and note the RMA/logistics. If replacements will arrive late and it impacts calls, we can approve a coworking stipend or ship a temporary headset. Also we'll set you up with an onboarding buddy  ping if you'd like an intro to Platform team folks.

Anna Rivera: Thanks folks. I moved the cert installer target to Login and it reported 'installed user cert (anna.rivera)'. VPN still errors though with "AUTH_FAIL: certificate not found by client". Happy to join a remote session if that helps. The monitor arm RMA sounds good  appreciate the quick responses!

Eli (IT): I'll start a quick remote session in 10 minutes to capture logs and check Keychain permissions. If we can't resolve the dock probe remotely, we'll mark IT-1988 for a replacement dock and ship a loaner headset today. Keep this thread open and we'll post updates once logistics confirms shipping. :thumbsup:
